{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for non-numeric values in 'revenue'
non_numeric = data[~data['revenue'].str.replace('.', '', 1).str.isnumeric()]
print("Non-numeric revenue values:")
print(non_numeric['revenue'].unique())

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
data['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(data['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for NaN values after conversion
print("\nNumber of NaN values in 'revenue' after conversion:", data['revenue'].isna().sum())

# Display the first few rows to confirm conversion
print("\nFirst few rows after conversion:")
data.head()"}
